## Gate 2.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 2.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=ac58c94a8886)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 5 (BLOCKER 0 / MAJOR 0 / MINOR 3 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 3, pending 2; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MINOR | The delta-added `--item` closed-skip branch (`fix_guard.py`: `skipped = 1 if is_closed(...)` / `if not skipped: bad += ...`) has no regression test; a dropped guard would silently re-enforce closed items or lose the `skipped_closed` marker, weakening AC-3 for this path. | ACTIONED | Addressed with closed-item output/mixed-case tests. |
| 2 | MINOR | The `is_closed` case-boundary change (raw value now passed to `backlog.section`) is untested: no test covers a mixed-case authority-dependent status (e.g. `WONT_FIX` vs `wont_fix`), so the exact contract with the case-sensitivity of `backlog.section` remains implicit (fail-closed direction only). | ACTIONED | Addressed with closed-item output/mixed-case tests. |
| 3 | MINOR | The new `test_fix_guard_problems_threads_meta` patches `fg.latest_review`, so it only holds if `problems` resolves that symbol at module scope; it verifies meta threading but not that the printed `mtime_fallback=` line reflects it end-to-end. | ACTIONED | Addressed with closed-item output/mixed-case tests. |
| 4 | NIT | When `--item` skips a closed item, `meta` stays empty and the line prints `mtime_fallback=0`, which is indistinguishable from "evaluated, no fallback"; consider an explicit "not evaluated" marker for log scraping. | PENDING | (no response yet) |
| 5 | NIT | Output-shape unification in `--item` is good, but the line still omits the item id (`item=<id>`), so `--all` and `--item` records are not uniformly greppable. | PENDING | (no response yet) |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Delta correctly resolves the prior MINORs (raw status to authority, meta threading test, `--item` skip marker, output-shape NIT) and stays within the approved scope with tooling-Python language rule satisfied.
  Remaining risks are test-coverage gaps on the new `--item` skip path and the unverified case-sensitivity contract at the `backlog.section` boundary.
  No blocker or contract-breaking issue; approve with the MINOR test additions.
=== 5 finding(s), 2 pending ===
